netguard.description:
NetGuard is a free and open-source Android firewall that allows you to control internet access for individual applications without requiring root access.

Block or allow Wi-Fi and mobile data connections separately for each app to improve privacy, reduce unnecessary data usage, and limit unwanted background network activity.

Features include per-app network access controls, IPv4 and IPv6 support, TCP and UDP filtering, roaming restrictions, screen-on connection rules, system app management, network usage monitoring, and optional connection notifications.

The GitHub version also supports hosts-file-based domain blocking to help reduce ads and tracking, as well as advanced port forwarding options. Optional Pro features include detailed traffic logs, per-address access rules, PCAP exports, and additional themes.

NetGuard uses Android's local VPN service to filter traffic on your device without sending it through an external VPN server. It does not require root access and contains no tracking or analytics.

Supports Android 5.1 and newer. A compatible device is required, and Android's VPN limitations prevent simultaneous use with other VPN apps.
